payload.core_mechanism_summary: Process queries in reverse: maintain an array mp where mp[x] is the final value after all replacements. For type 1, output mp[x]; for type 2, set mp[x] = mp[y].
payload.rationale: The solution uses a mapping from each integer to its replacement target, implemented via an array for O(1) updates. Reverse processing correctly resolves later replacements overriding earlier ones, akin to a hash map but using a direct array.
